imageAlt.en: Cover related to: Meta's Muse Is Better at Surveilling Than Helping Me
imageAlt.zh-TW: 相關封面圖：Meta（Meta）的Muse（Muse）推升股價 儘管隱私與安全問題浮現

title.en: Meta's Muse Fuels Stock Gains Despite Privacy and Security Issues
title.zh-TW: Meta（Meta）的Muse（Muse）推升股價 儘管隱私與安全問題浮現

summary.en: Meta's new AI assistant Muse has boosted the company's stock to its best month in over a decade according to MarketWatch, with strong download numbers outpacing early ChatGPT. However, Wired and Ars Technica report concerns over data collection and a zero-day vulnerability, while Amazon has begun blocking the app.
summary.zh-TW: 根據MarketWatch報導，Meta（Meta）的新AI助理Muse（Muse）推升公司股價至十多年來最佳表現，下載量超越早期ChatGPT（ChatGPT）。不過Wired與Ars Technica指出資料蒐集疑慮及零時差漏洞，而Amazon（Amazon）已開始封鎖該應用。

body.en: Lede: Meta's Muse AI assistant is driving investor optimism and stock performance even as reports highlight surveillance features and a critical security flaw. What happened: MarketWatch noted Meta’s stock enjoying its best month in 13 years thanks to Muse gaining popularity and convincing investors that AI bets are paying off. TechCrunch reported Muse outpacing ChatGPT’s early mobile launch with more downloads and daily active users in the U.S. and Canada. Ars Technica detailed a zero-day vulnerability allowing local apps full control, contradicting Mark Zuckerberg’s privacy claims, and Amazon blocking Muse from its site. Wired described Muse as better at surveilling users by opting them into AI training data collection and nudging sharing of bank, email, and passport details. Why it matters: The finance angle centers on how positive adoption metrics are lifting Meta shares, yet emerging security and privacy issues could affect long-term investor confidence in the company’s AI push. Sources agree/disagree: All sources confirm Muse’s recent launch and rapid user growth. MarketWatch focuses on stock benefits while Wired and Ars Technica emphasize data and security risks. Still uncertain: The exact duration of Meta’s stock performance streak shows variation across reports.
body.zh-TW: 導言：Meta（Meta）的Muse（Muse）AI助理正驅動投資人樂觀情緒與股價表現，儘管報導指出其監控功能與關鍵安全漏洞。 事件經過：MarketWatch指出Meta（Meta）股價因Muse（Muse） popularity上升而享受13年來最佳月份，並說服投資人AI投注正見成效。TechCrunch報導Muse（Muse）在美國與加拿大下載量及每日活躍用戶超越ChatGPT（ChatGPT）早期行動版推出表現。Ars Technica詳述零時差漏洞允許本地應用完全控制，與Mark Zuckerberg（Mark Zuckerberg）隱私宣稱相悖，且Amazon（Amazon）已封鎖Muse（Muse）。Wired描述Muse（Muse）更擅長監控用戶，預設加入AI訓練資料蒐集並提示分享銀行、電子郵件與護照資訊。 重要性：財務角度聚焦正面採用指標如何推升Meta（Meta）股價，但新興安全與隱私問題可能影響公司AI推動的長期投資信心。 來源一致與分歧：所有來源確認Muse（Muse）近期推出與快速用戶成長。MarketWatch聚焦股價利益，Wired與Ars Technica強調資料與安全風險。 仍未確定：Meta（Meta）股價表現連續期間在報導中顯示差異。

disagreements.en: MarketWatch states best month in 13 years while its linked URL references more than two years.
disagreements.zh-TW: MarketWatch稱13年來最佳月份，但其連結URL提及超過兩年。

blurb.en: Company developing the Muse AI assistant.
blurb.zh-TW: 開發Muse（Muse）AI助理的公司。

blurb.en: Meta's new AI assistant for tasks like booking appointments.
blurb.zh-TW: Meta（Meta）用於預約等任務的新AI助理。

blurb.en: Meta founder and CEO who promoted Muse security.
blurb.zh-TW: Meta（Meta）創辦人兼執行長，曾宣傳Muse（Muse）安全性。

blurb.en: Company that began blocking Muse from its site.
blurb.zh-TW: 開始從其網站封鎖Muse（Muse）的公司。

imageAlt.en: Cover related to: U.N. General Assembly to Confront Familiar Crises, New Conflicts and A.I.
imageAlt.zh-TW: 相關封面圖：聯合國大會（United Nations General Assembly）將面對危機、衝突與人工智慧

title.en: United Nations General Assembly to Confront Crises, Conflicts and A.I.
title.zh-TW: 聯合國大會（United Nations General Assembly）將面對危機、衝突與人工智慧

summary.en: World leaders gather at the U.N. General Assembly to discuss AI risks, autonomous weapons, ongoing conflicts, and the search for a new secretary general after António Guterres completes his terms. NPR and NYT reports highlight these agenda items.
summary.zh-TW: 世界領袖聚集聯合國大會（United Nations General Assembly），討論人工智慧風險、自主武器、持續衝突，以及安東尼奧·古特雷斯（António Guterres）任期結束後尋找新秘書長事宜。NPR與NYT報導強調這些議程項目。

body.en: Lede: The United Nations General Assembly opens its annual debate amid familiar global crises, emerging conflicts, and rising concerns over artificial intelligence. What happened: NPR World reports that AI and autonomous weapons top the agenda, with Colombia's former president and Nobel Peace Prize laureate addressing risks. NYT World notes the assembly confronts ongoing crises plus the need to replace António Guterres after two terms. NPR World also features former UN Deputy Secretary General Mark Malloch-Brown discussing the organization's role in current conflicts. Why it matters: Discussions on autonomous weapons and AI signal growing international focus on regulating emerging technologies in warfare and governance. Leadership transition planning underscores institutional continuity at the UN. Sources agree/disagree: NPR World and NYT World both emphasize AI on the agenda and the secretary general transition; NPR World adds details on autonomous weapons and features Malloch-Brown. Still uncertain: Specific outcomes of debates and the identity of Guterres' successor remain open.
body.zh-TW: 導言：聯合國大會（United Nations General Assembly）年度辯論在熟悉的全球危機、新興衝突以及對人工智慧日益關注中開幕。 事件經過：NPR World報導人工智慧與自主武器位居議程首位，哥倫比亞前總統暨諾貝爾和平獎得主討論相關風險。NYT World指出大會面對持續危機以及安東尼奧·古特雷斯（António Guterres）兩任期滿後尋找繼任者。NPR World亦邀請前聯合國副秘書長馬克·馬洛克-布朗（Mark Malloch-Brown）探討該組織在當前衝突中的角色。 重要性：關於自主武器與人工智慧的討論顯示國際社會日益重視規範新興戰爭與治理科技。領導層交接規劃凸顯聯合國機構延續性。 來源一致／分歧：NPR World與NYT World均強調人工智慧議程及秘書長交接；NPR World補充自主武器細節並邀請馬克·馬洛克-布朗（Mark Malloch-Brown）。 仍未確定：辯論具體結果及古特雷斯（António Guterres）繼任者身分仍待觀察。

term.zh-TW: 聯合國大會（United Nations General Assembly）

blurb.en: Annual gathering of world leaders for debate on global issues.
blurb.zh-TW: 世界領袖年度聚會，討論全球議題。

term.zh-TW: 安東尼奧·古特雷斯（António Guterres）

blurb.en: Current UN secretary general completing two terms.
blurb.zh-TW: 現任聯合國秘書長，任期兩屆即將結束。

blurb.zh-TW: 前聯合國副秘書長。

imageAlt.zh-TW: 相關封面圖：王識賢（Wang Shi-xian）與《網紅老爸》票房破7800萬 全台86場映後「1句話」逼哭影迷

title.en: Wang Shi-xian and 'Internet Celebrity Dad' Film Surpass NT$78 Million at Box Office with 86 Post-Screening Events
title.zh-TW: 王識賢（Wang Shi-xian）與《網紅老爸》票房破7800萬 全台86場映後「1句話」逼哭影迷

summary.en: Taiwanese actor Wang Shi-xian promoted the film 'Internet Celebrity Dad' across 86 events nationwide. The movie, made by the 'Corner' team, has exceeded NT$78 million in box office. One remark by Wang moved fans who lost their fathers to tears during screenings.
summary.zh-TW: 台灣演員王識賢（Wang Shi-xian）為電影《網紅老爸》舉辦全台86場映後活動。該片由《角頭》團隊打造，票房已突破7800萬。王識賢的一句話讓喪父影迷感動落淚。

body.en: Lede: Actor Wang Shi-xian drew emotional responses from audiences during post-screening events for the film 'Internet Celebrity Dad'. What happened: The movie reached over NT$78.68 million in Taiwan box office by its fourth weekend. Wang participated in 86 events across the island. At one event he answered a question about what he most wanted to say to his daughter, prompting tears from viewers who had lost their fathers. Additional events included a special 'I Love You' screening in Taipei, Taichung and Kaohsiung where cast members shared behind-the-scenes stories. Why it matters: The film continues the universe of the popular 'Corner' series and has sustained strong audience engagement through personal interactions. Sources agree/disagree: Outlets report consistent details on the box office milestone, the number of events and the emotional impact of Wang's comment. Still uncertain: Exact wording of the remark that moved audiences is not specified in the provided sources.
body.zh-TW: 導言：演員王識賢（Wang Shi-xian）在電影《網紅老爸》映後活動中，引起觀眾情感共鳴。 事件經過：該片上映第四週末全台票房突破7868萬。王識賢參與全台86場映後活動。在其中一場，他回答最想對女兒說的話，讓喪父影迷落淚。另有台北、台中、高雄的「啾愛你限定場」，演員分享拍攝趣事。 重要性：此片延續《角頭》系列世界觀，透過映後互動維持觀眾熱度。 來源一致與分歧：各報導對票房里程碑、活動場次及王識賢發言的感動效果描述一致。 仍未確定：王識賢讓觀眾感動的那句話確切內容，來源未提供細節。

disagreements.en: Box office reported as 7868萬 in one source and 7800萬 in others.
disagreements.zh-TW: 票房數字一處報導為7868萬，其他來源為7800萬。

blurb.en: Taiwanese actor who promoted 'Internet Celebrity Dad' at 86 events.
blurb.zh-TW: 台灣演員，為《網紅老爸》舉辦86場映後活動。

blurb.en: Film produced by the 'Corner' team that has surpassed NT$78 million at the Taiwan box office.
blurb.zh-TW: 由《角頭》團隊打造，台灣票房已突破7800萬的電影。

imageAlt.en: Cover related to: Bungie says it’s ‘not done with Destiny’ and will bring back vaulted content
imageAlt.zh-TW: 相關封面圖：Bungie（Bungie）撤銷《Destiny》內容金庫 計畫恢復戰役突襲與目的地

title.en: Bungie Reverses Destiny Content Vault to Restore Campaigns Raids and Destinations
title.zh-TW: Bungie（Bungie）撤銷《Destiny》內容金庫 計畫恢復戰役突襲與目的地

summary.en: Bungie states it is not done with Destiny and plans to restore previously vaulted content including campaigns, destinations, and raids. The move reverses the Destiny Content Vault introduced six years ago that removed paid player content. Bungie acknowledges the impact on player trust.
summary.zh-TW: Bungie（Bungie）表示未放棄《Destiny》，計畫恢復先前封存的戰役、目的地與突襲內容。此舉逆轉六年前推出的《Destiny》內容金庫，該機制移除玩家已付費取得的內容。Bungie（Bungie）承認此舉影響玩家信任。

body.en: Lede: Bungie has announced plans to bring back vaulted Destiny content after previously appearing to step away from the franchise. What happened: Bungie confirmed it will restore campaigns, destinations, and raids removed through the Destiny Content Vault created six years ago. The studio admitted the removals affected player trust and enjoyment. Why it matters: Restoring paid content addresses long-standing player concerns and signals renewed commitment to Destiny 2. Sources agree/disagree: The Verge and Engadget both report Bungie leaders stating the studio is not done with Destiny. Engadget additionally notes a promise that Marathon will continue to grow. Still uncertain: Exact timelines and scope of restored content remain unspecified in the reports.
body.zh-TW: 導言：Bungie（Bungie）宣布計畫恢復已封存的《Destiny》內容，此前該工作室看似已放棄此系列。 事件經過：Bungie（Bungie）確認將恢復六年前透過《Destiny》內容金庫移除的戰役、目的地與突襲。該工作室承認移除內容影響玩家信任與享受。 重要性：恢復已付費內容回應玩家長期疑慮，並顯示對《Destiny 2》的持續投入。 來源共識與分歧：The Verge 與 Engadget 均報導 Bungie（Bungie）領導層表示工作室未放棄《Destiny》。Engadget 另提及 Marathon 將持續成長的承諾。 仍未確定：恢復內容的確切時間表與範圍在報導中未具體說明。

blurb.en: Game studio developing Destiny and Marathon.
blurb.zh-TW: 開發《Destiny》與 Marathon 的遊戲工作室。

blurb.en: Video game franchise by Bungie.
blurb.zh-TW: Bungie（Bungie）推出的遊戲系列。

blurb.en: System created six years ago by Bungie to remove older content from Destiny 2.
blurb.zh-TW: Bungie（Bungie）六年前建立的系統，用於移除《Destiny 2》舊內容。

blurb.en: Game by Bungie that the studio says will keep growing.
blurb.zh-TW: Bungie（Bungie）表示將持續發展的遊戲。

imageAlt.en: Cover related to: Taylor Swift Shows Off Wedding Ring as Travis Kelce Scores First Touchdown of the Season
imageAlt.zh-TW: 相關封面圖：泰勒·斯威夫特（Taylor Swift）在箭頭體育場（Arrowhead Stadium）慶祝泰拉維斯·凱爾斯（Travis Kelce）本季首達陣

title.en: Taylor Swift Celebrates Travis Kelce First Touchdown at Arrowhead Stadium
title.zh-TW: 泰勒·斯威夫特（Taylor Swift）在箭頭體育場（Arrowhead Stadium）慶祝泰拉維斯·凱爾斯（Travis Kelce）本季首達陣

summary.en: Taylor Swift cheered from her suite as husband Travis Kelce scored his first touchdown of the 2026 NFL season for the Kansas City Chiefs against the Indianapolis Colts. She showed off her wedding ring during the primetime game at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, Missouri on September 20.
summary.zh-TW: 泰勒·斯威夫特（Taylor Swift）在堪薩斯市箭頭體育場（Arrowhead Stadium）包廂為丈夫泰拉維斯·凱爾斯（Travis Kelce）本季首達陣歡呼。她在9月20日晚場堪薩斯城酋長隊對印第安納波利斯小馬隊比賽中展示婚戒。

body.en: Lede: Taylor Swift pointed to her wedding ring while celebrating Travis Kelce scoring the first touchdown of his 2026 NFL season. What happened: During the Kansas City Chiefs primetime matchup against the Indianapolis Colts at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, Missouri on Sunday September 20, the 36-year-old pop superstar cheered from her suite as Kelce found the end zone. She exclaimed 'That’s My Husband!' according to reports. Why it matters: The moment highlights the ongoing public interest in the celebrity couple’s relationship amid the NFL season. Sources agree/disagree: Billboard and Rolling Stone both report the touchdown celebration and Swift’s presence at the game with consistent details on the date, teams, and location. Still uncertain: No additional details on the final score or other game events are provided beyond the Chiefs triumph.
body.zh-TW: 導言：泰勒·斯威夫特（Taylor Swift）在慶祝泰拉維斯·凱爾斯（Travis Kelce）攻下2026年NFL球季首達陣時展示婚戒。 事件經過：9月20日星期日晚場，36歲流行巨星在密蘇里州堪薩斯市箭頭體育場（Arrowhead Stadium）包廂觀看堪薩斯城酋長隊對印第安納波利斯小馬隊比賽，為丈夫達陣歡呼。 事件意義：此舉凸顯大眾對這對名人夫妻關係在NFL球季中的持續關注。 來源一致與分歧：Billboard與Rolling Stone均報導達陣慶祝及斯威夫特現身賽事，日期、球隊與地點細節一致。 仍未確定：除酋長隊獲勝外，無其他比賽最終比分或細節。

disagreements.en: Figures differ across outlets (e.g. 21 vs 20 in headlines/snippets).
disagreements.zh-TW: 不同媒體的數字有所不同（例如，標題/摘要中的數字為 21 比 20）。

blurb.en: 36-year-old pop superstar mentioned in the sources.
blurb.zh-TW: 來源中提及的36歲流行巨星。

blurb.en: Taylor Swift's husband and Kansas City Chiefs player who scored the touchdown.
blurb.zh-TW: 泰勒·斯威夫特（Taylor Swift）丈夫及堪薩斯城酋長隊球員，攻下達陣。

term.zh-TW: 堪薩斯城酋長隊（Kansas City Chiefs）

blurb.zh-TW: 在報導比賽中擊敗印第安納波利斯小馬隊的NFL球隊。

imageAlt.zh-TW: 相關封面圖：LISANI！TAIPEI 2026（LISANI！TAIPEI 2026）11月登場！10組動漫歌手、聲優連唱2天 10／3正式開賣

title.en: LISANI！TAIPEI 2026 to Host 10 Anime Singer and Voice Actor Groups for Two-Day Concert in November
title.zh-TW: LISANI！TAIPEI 2026（LISANI！TAIPEI 2026）11月登場！10組動漫歌手、聲優連唱2天 10／3正式開賣

summary.en: The LISANI！TAIPEI 2026 event is set to take place in November with performances by 10 groups of anime singers and voice actors over two days. Ticket sales begin on October 3. Multiple Taiwanese entertainment outlets report identical details about the concert lineup and schedule.
summary.zh-TW: 《LISANI！TAIPEI 2026》（LISANI！TAIPEI 2026）預計11月登場，由10組動漫歌手與聲優連唱2天，10月3日正式開賣。多家台灣娛樂媒體報導活動陣容與時程細節一致。

body.en: Lede: LISANI！TAIPEI 2026 is scheduled for a November debut featuring 10 groups of anime singers and voice actors performing across two days. What happened: Reports confirm the event will run for two consecutive days in November, with ticket sales officially starting on October 3. Why it matters: The concert brings together multiple anime music acts and seiyuu performers in Taipei, highlighting ongoing interest in anime-related live events in the region. Sources agree/disagree: All listed sources from Yahoo TW, Google News TW, and LINE TODAY present identical information on the event name, performer count, duration, and sale date with no variations. Still uncertain: Specific venue details, exact performance dates within November, and the identities of the 10 groups are not provided in the sources.
body.zh-TW: 導言：LISANI！TAIPEI 2026（LISANI！TAIPEI 2026）預計11月登場，由10組動漫歌手與聲優連唱2天。 事件經過：報導指出活動將在11月連續舉辦2天，門票於10月3日正式開賣。 重要性：此演唱會匯集多組動漫音樂表演者與聲優，在台北呈現相關現場活動的持續關注。 來源一致／分歧：Yahoo TW、Google News TW與LINE TODAY等來源對活動名稱、表演團數、持續天數及開賣日期均呈現相同資訊，無任何差異。 仍未確定：11月內確切演出日期、場地細節以及10組團體的具體成員，來源中均未提供。

blurb.en: An upcoming anime music concert event scheduled in Taipei.
blurb.zh-TW: 預計在台北舉辦的動漫音樂演唱會活動。

imageAlt.en: Cover related to: 遭爆11年婚變協議離婚方志友！楊銘威首公開現身了 「最新近況」曝 - Yahoo新聞
imageAlt.zh-TW: 相關封面圖：方志友（Fang Chih-yu）與楊銘威（Yang Ming-wei）宣布結束11年婚姻

title.en: Fang Chih-yu and Yang Ming-wei Announce 11-Year Marriage End
title.zh-TW: 方志友（Fang Chih-yu）與楊銘威（Yang Ming-wei）宣布結束11年婚姻

summary.en: Taiwanese celebrities Fang Chih-yu and Yang Ming-wei have announced their divorce after 11 years, stating they will remain family. Yang Ming-wei was seen publicly for the first time since the news. Separate reports detail singer Wu Shu-min entering court mediation over her 7-year marriage amid alleged domestic violence claims.
summary.zh-TW: 台灣藝人方志友（Fang Chih-yu）與楊銘威（Yang Ming-wei）宣布結束11年婚姻，強調仍是一家人。楊銘威自消息曝光後首度公開現身。另有報導指出歌手吳淑敏（Wu Shu-min）因7年婚姻問題進入法院調解，並傳出家暴指控。

body.en: Lede: Fang Chih-yu and Yang Ming-wei have ended their 11-year marriage through agreement, with both parties confirming they remain family. What happened: Multiple outlets report the couple's divorce filing, with Yang Ming-wei making his first public appearance afterward. Past comments from Jia Jing-wen about Yang Ming-wei's behavior at home have resurfaced alongside Fang Chih-yu's earlier admissions of considering leaving the marriage. Separate coverage covers singer Wu Shu-min appearing in court for mediation in her 7-year marriage, acknowledging alleged domestic violence incidents. Why it matters: These cases highlight ongoing celebrity marriage strains in Taiwan entertainment circles. summary.en: CNN, MS Now (formerly MSNBC) and Politico sued the Trump administration after their White House access badges were disabled. The outlets accuse the president of violating the US constitution by banning them over coverage. The suit was filed Monday in US district court. Major networks later suspended White House TV coverage as Trump heads to the UN summit.

body.en: Lede: CNN, MS Now and Politico have filed a lawsuit against the Trump White House after being banned from the premises. What happened: Three news organizations – CNN, MS Now (formerly MSNBC) and Politico – that have been denied access to the White House have sued to regain their ability to enter the building. The suit was filed on Monday morning in the US district court. President Trump announced the ban on his Truth Social platform on Friday, expelling the outlets effective immediately over what he called their constant fake news reporting. Major US networks later suspended White House TV coverage of Trump as he heads to New York for the UN summit. Why it matters: In what will be one of the largest battles yet between the press and Donald Trump’s administration, the outlets accuse the president of violating the US constitution. Trump has overseen an unprecedented restriction of access for major news media since the start of his second term. Sources agree/disagree: All sources confirm the lawsuit filing, the ban announcement on Truth Social, and the outlets involved. Still uncertain: Details on the exact court outcome or further network actions remain pending.

body.zh-TW: 導言：已故桃莉·帕頓（Dolly Parton）的姪子布萊恩·西弗（Bryan Seaver）已被解除其擔任的安保主管職務。 事件經過：Just Jared與TMZ報導，西弗於9月16日收到解雇通知，他與其公司立即被解除在桃莉·帕頓所有資產的職務，包括她位於納什維爾的主要住宅、博物館以及市中心住所。西弗曾宣布她的死訊，並長期擔任安保職位。 重要性：此突然變動被描述為加劇了遺產爭議。 來源一致與分歧：Just Jared與TMZ均描述西弗及其公司遭解雇，並與遺產緊張局勢有關。 仍未確定：來源未提供發出通知的確切當事人或進一步遺產程序的細節。

blurb.zh-TW: 桃莉·帕頓（Dolly Parton）的姪子，前任其資產安保主管。

blurb.en: Late country music superstar whose properties and estate are referenced.
blurb.zh-TW: 已故鄉村音樂巨星，其資產與遺產被提及。

imageAlt.zh-TW: 相關封面圖：若韋內爾·莫伊塞（Jovenel Moïse）遇刺案：18名嫌犯引渡至美國

title.en: Jovenel Moïse Assassination: 18 Suspects Extradited to United States
title.zh-TW: 若韋內爾·莫伊塞（Jovenel Moïse）遇刺案：18名嫌犯引渡至美國

summary.en: Eighteen suspects arrested in the 2021 killing of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse are being extradited to the U.S. to face justice in Florida, according to NPR World. The move follows their arrests related to the July 2021 assassination.
summary.zh-TW: 根據NPR World報導，2021年海地總統若韋內爾·莫伊塞（Jovenel Moïse）遇刺案中被捕的18名嫌犯，正被引渡至美國佛羅里達州接受審判。此舉發生在他們於2021年7月遇刺案中被捕之後。

body.en: Lede: Eighteen suspects in the 2021 assassination of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse are being extradited to the United States. What happened: The suspects, arrested following the July 2021 killing, were extradited on Sunday to face justice in Florida. Why it matters: The extradition brings the accused to U.S. courts for prosecution in a high-profile international case. Sources agree/disagree: Only one source reports on this event. Still uncertain: No additional details on the suspects' identities or trial timeline are available from the provided sources.
body.zh-TW: 導言：2021年海地總統若韋內爾·莫伊塞（Jovenel Moïse）遇刺案中的18名嫌犯正被引渡至美國。 事件經過：這些嫌犯在2021年7月遇刺案中被捕後，於週日被引渡至佛羅里達州接受審判。 重要性：此引渡將被告帶至美國法院，處理這起備受關注的國際案件。 來源一致／分歧：僅有一個來源報導此事件。 仍不確定：來源未提供嫌犯身分或審判時間表的其他細節。

blurb.en: President of Haiti assassinated in July 2021.
blurb.zh-TW: 2021年7月遇刺的海地總統。
